evidence: King Tubby is the credited mixer/engineer on 'King Tubbys Meets Rockers Uptown' (1976), built from Pablo's own rhythms and melodica takes.

trackPair.whatToListenFor: Pablo's melodica is the constant; what changes across his catalogue is how much of everything else Tubby lets vanish around it. On the 1976 record, whole bars drop to just melodica, echo, and a bass note.

explanation: Pablo wrote and played the melodica parts. Tubby remixed them, dropping instruments in and out and adding huge echo, the same technique he used on vocal records. It is a rare case in dub of the technique being applied to an instrumental from the start, rather than to a vocal song dubbed afterwards, which shows Tubby's mixing as a general method, not a trick only for vocals.
